digest.component_or_area: MCP error handling / workflow engine integration
propositions: MCP tools render_workflow and get_workflow_status return error code 'llm_unavailable' for caller-input and not-found failures instead of a distinct error code like 'not_found'
error_code_for function blanket-maps every LLMError subclass to 'llm_unavailable', including WorkflowError and WorkflowParseError which represent caller mistakes not backend unavailability
_structured_llm_failure hard-codes 'llm_unavailable' for all LLM-tier tool failures regardless of whether the root cause is availability, parsing, or not-found
driving agents cannot distinguish retryable outages from unrecoverable caller-input errors without parsing error message text, defeating the structured error contract
fix introduces WorkflowNotFoundError subclass and per-subclass error code routing (not_found for lookups, invalid_input for parse failures, llm_unavailable only for genuine outages)
